payload.meta_description: Where to send digital save the dates, from Paperless Post and Greenvelope to Canva and Etsy, plus timing and passport tips for guests travelling abroad.

audience.notes: Australian couples in their 30s, AUD 150K+, many marrying abroad with guests in several countries. They want a save the date that looks considered, reaches everyone (including older relatives), and starts the travel conversation early. Parents care that relatives overseas actually receive it.

payload.search_intent: Commercial investigation with transactional pull: find a site to make and send a digital save the date, and know whether it can track replies and collect addresses.
payload.angle: The sites worth using, sorted by what they actually do (send and track, or design a file you send yourself), judged on what matters when guests fly in from several countries: delivery by email, text or WhatsApp, open and reply tracking, address collection, and a link to a wedding website with travel details.
serp_gaps_to_win: AU top 3 is Etsy, local stationers and Pinterest; only one editorial guide (a website-builder competitor). A neutral, dated sites list wins the editorial slot.
Nobody covers international guests: text delivery limits by country, WhatsApp, time zones, passport validity reminders.
Nobody separates design-a-file tools from send-and-track platforms.
Related searches 'digital save the date with RSVP' and 'that collect addresses' are unanswered by the AU results.

format_match.sibling: https://weddedwonderland.com/wedding-tools/online-wedding-shower-invitations (LIVE, 200, published 18 Nov 2026, author Mark Tuason, about 1,100 words)
pattern: Answer-first intro paragraph: a one-sentence definition, then the platforms named in one sentence, then a one-line note on what they share (tracking replies).
One internal link sentence straight after the intro.
'Key takeaways' box of 4 bullets with prices and one practical warning.
One H2 per platform, heading pattern '<Platform> for <what it is best for>' (e.g. 'Evite for Free Invitations With RSVP Tracking', 'Greenvelope for Animated Envelopes and Meal Choices').

Each platform section: 2 short paragraphs. First names the platform as a plain link to its official category page at first mention, then states free or paid, prices in original currency (US$ written as 'US$17.99'), delivery channels and limits. Second covers RSVP and guest-messaging features. No scores, no affiliate links, no superlatives.
File-only options grouped in one H2 ('Etsy and Zazzle for Invitations You Send Yourself') with a caution that a file does not collect replies.
Timing H2 citing the platforms' own guidance by name ('Evite suggests...'), then internal links.
Closing H2 with internal links, then the Wonderland Studio mention in one sentence, then the Studio CTA box ('Wedding RSVPs in one place').
FAQ of 4 questions, each answered in 3 to 4 sentences, naming platforms.
2 inline images from our library with captions and photo credits, plus cover credit.
